steps.assistant_text: IDO 7.1 NCC donor finished from the 99.79 NM donor (agent-c run 287). The run-285 folded x2C use made the x2C load a v1 LR so the merge took t0, but the ugen ring was one off. Replacing it with a phantom int pk (pk = (int)a1->tbl at the top of every iteration, folded 0 * (pk + pk) on the call argument) keeps v1 occupied across the merge (t0) while x2C stays a ugen temp; naming the destination argument (char *dst = m->x54 + off before the call) makes ugen evaluate m / x54 before x2C: t2 / t3 / t4 like the target. Two volatile pads dropped for pk's home (frame 0x70). Spliced over a placeholder on both build paths; blank relocs bind to the existing gl_func_00000000 / gl_data_0001EE5C / gl_data_0001EE70 pins.
